text.p: Mecon Inc Thursday announced restructuring moves in response to the company's previously announced, preliminary, unaudited results for the fourth quarter ended March 31, 1997.

Les Schmidt, the company's president and chief executive Officer, has resigned to pursue other interests, Mecon said. Vasu Devan, chairman of the company, will add to his current position the additional roles of President and Chief Executive Officer, positions he had held previously.
Mecon also announced a number of strategic and operational changes intended to improve the company's financial performance.
The company said it would immediately decrease its workforce by 38 employees and incur a charge of approximately $750,000 during the first quarter of fiscal 1998.

"These streamlining actions and the reduction in the Company's overall quarterly operating expenses, along with our renewed focus on Mecon's historical growth markets, have been implemented in an effort to expedite the Company's return to profitability and growth," said Devan.

"While we do not anticipate an immediate return to Mecon's historical operating results, the Company continues to benefit from its strong balance sheet and its ongoing base of recurring subscription and license revenue."

Mecon said April 7 it expected to report a pre-tax loss in the range of $1.7 million to $1.9 million in the fourth quarter eded March 31 because of a significant and unanticipated shortfall in orders.
